contract: With epsilon_t=alpha*t^{-alpha}, the displayed v1 regret, which sums T feedbacks but subtracts Kant once, must obey the displayed confidence and approximation terms.

alternative_contract.claim: On the audited nonconstant 2x2 instance, standard Kantorovich regret subtracting the optimum every round is zero for the repeated exact Kantorovich optimizer.
alternative_contract.VERIFIED: The optimizer objective is recomputed from its plan, corrected regret and the printed-regret decomposition residual are below 1e-12, and an independent checker agrees.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: An admissible Lipschitz OT instance has an action-independent printed-regret lower bound above a uniform upper bound on all displayed RHS terms.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: The literal definition and scheduled theorem inequality are proved together.
